==Behind the scenes==
The metric system is the primary form of measurement. However, temperature units would not be named [[Wikipedia:Lord Kelvin|Kelvin]], or [[Wikipedia:Gabriel Fahrenheit|Fahrenheit]], since they were named for men from Earth, but rather by [[Wikipedia:centigrade|centigrade]] or the more benign "standard" developed in the online Visual Guides. Despite this, certain units are used that are named after scientists from Earth, including [[Wikipedia:Anders Celsius|celsius]], [[Wikipedia:James Watt|watt]], [[Wikipedia:James Prescott Joule|joule]], and [[Wikipedia:Heinrich Rudolf Hertz|hertz]].

The metric system also applies to quantities as well, beyond the standard SI prefix. See [[Wikipedia:Names_of large numbers|Large Numbers]] for more details.
